NCT/
CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
S.I, Special Branch 4666
No.
REPORT
Date Nov. 3, 1938.
Subject Sidney Frank Hearne (British), applicant for enlistment
in 1st Battalion, The Seaforth Highlanders.
Made by D.S.I. Logan Forwarded by

Reference the attached communication from the
Officer Commanding, 1st Battalion, The Seaforth Highlanders,
requesting a report on the character, etc. of Sidney Frank
Hearne (British), 20 years, applicant for enlistment in the
aforesaid Regiment, enquiries reveal that he was born at Kobe,
Japan, where his father was a hotel manager, on January 7,
1918. His childhood was partly spent in China where he
received some education. One of his British teachers
stated, when interviewed, that while in school, his behaviour
was exemplary but that he was consistently a backward student,
though in athletics he distinguished himself above the
average. Very little is known of his movements and
character during adolescence. As will be seen from the
attached Certificate of Discharge, he served a period of
one year and 209 days in the Australian Militia Forces, which
he left at his own request on September 5, 1938. Accompanied
by his mother, he travelled from Sydney, Australia, to
Shanghai on the s.s. Nellore, arriving on October 10, 1938.
He is described by a fellow passenger as having been of good
behaviour throughout the voyage, quiet in his habits and
apparently, was completely under his mother's influence.
His conversation is stated to have indicated that his
mentality is more like that of a child than a young man.
On October 10, 1938, he applied for a position on the Shanghai
Municipal Gaol staff and was given the usual educational test
but failed to qualify, his spelling, grammar and arithmetic
being very poor.

档案号
S.I，特务科 4666
编号
报告
日期 1938年11月3日。
事由 西德尼·弗兰克·赫恩（Sidney Frank Hearne）（英国人），申请加入海福尔高地团（The Seaforth Highlanders）第一营。
呈报人 副督察长洛根（Logan） 转呈人

兹参照随附的海福尔高地团第一营指挥官来函，该函要求就西德尼·弗兰克·赫恩（英国人，20岁，上述团体的入伍申请人）的品行等情况提交报告。经查询获悉，他于1918年1月7日出生于日本神户，其父当时任一家酒店经理。他的童年部分在中国度过，并在此接受了一些教育。一位英国教师在接受问询时表示，赫恩在校期间行为堪称楷模，但学业始终落后，尽管在体育运动方面表现优于常人。关于他青少年时期的行踪和品行，知之甚少。从随附的退伍证明书可见，他在澳大利亚民兵部队服役一年零209天，并于1938年9月5日应其本人请求离职。他在母亲陪同下，乘坐“内洛尔”号轮船（s.s. Nellore）从澳大利亚悉尼前往上海，于1938年10月10日抵达。据一位同船乘客描述，他在整个航程中行为良好，生活习惯安静，且显然完全受其母亲影响。据说他的言谈表明，其心智更像孩童而非青年。1938年10月10日，他申请上海公共租界监狱职员职位，并参加了常规的文化测试，但未能合格，其拼写、语法和算术能力均非常差。

1st Battalion The Seaforth Highlanders,
Race Course Billets,
Shanghai.
31st. October, 1938.

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai.
------------------------------------

Dear Sir,

SIDNEY FRANK HEARN of Crossgrove House, Lane
1220, has presented himself at this Headquarters for
enlistment into the Regiment.

He has produced a "testimonial"; "Certificate
of Discharge from the Australian Forces" and his birth
certificate which I forward herewith for your information
and return please.

Before deciding to accept the man for enlist-
ment, I would be greatly obliged if you could give me
any report on this man's character, etc.

Yours faithfully,

Lieutenant-Colonel,
Commanding,
1st Battalion The Seaforth Highlanders.

1938年10月31日
海福尔高地团第一营，
跑马厅营房，
上海。
1938年10月31日。

致：
上海警务处处长。
------------------------------------

尊敬的先生：

住在爱文义路1220弄 Crossgrove House 的西德尼·弗兰克·赫恩已来到本总部，申请加入本团。

他出示了一份“推荐信”、“澳大利亚军队退伍证明书”以及他的出生证明，现随函附上供您查阅，并请阅后退回。

在决定接受此人入伍之前，如蒙您提供有关此人性品等方面的任何报告，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼，

中校，
指挥官，
海福尔高地团第一营。
